claude_proposed_widenings.name: mixed-casting-time charge-cast spell menu on magic items
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item charge-cast pattern ties one activationCost to the whole item activation. Cube of Force grants multiple spells off one shared charge pool, but those spells do not share a single casting time. An honest encoding needs the item to supply charges and DC while each granted spell keeps its own casting-time semantics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it..." plus the table includes "Shield" alongside "Mage Armor," "Tiny Hut," "Private Sanctum," "Resilient Sphere," and "Wall of Force."
